records.rationale: In lib/topic_retriever.rb, retrieved_recently? does `$redis.setnx(retrieved_key, "1")` followed by `$redis.expire(retrieved_key, 60)`. records.issue_text: PollFeed lacks per-item error handling: one malformed feed item (missing content, nil title, or duplicate embed_url race) raises an unrescued exception that aborts the entire run with retry: false, silently skipping all subsequent items
records.rationale: In `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed`, the code unconditionally calls `i.content.scrub` (`content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`). If a feed item lacks a `content` field (i.e., `i.content` is `nil`), this will raise `NoMethodError` on `nil.scrub`.
